opinions.text: Sup. Ct. App. W. Va. Motions for leave to file briefs as amici curiae filed by the following were granted: National Insurance Crime Bureau et al.; Michael D. Riley, West Virginia Insurance Commissioner; West Virginia Mutual Insurance Co.; DRI-The Voice of the Defense Bar; National Association of Mutual Insurance Cos. et al.; American Tort Reform Assn.; and Washington Legal Foundation et al. Certio-rari denied.
